name: compliance-monitor
description: Regulatory change tracking, filing deadline management, audit prep checklists, and compliance calendar maintenance for accounting and finance firms. Use when you need to track IRS/state deadlines, monitor regulatory updates (GAAP, FASB, IRS, state tax), prepare audit checklists, or manage client compliance calendars. NOT for legal advice, securities compliance (SEC/FINRA), or tax preparation itself — use a tax specialist for actual filing work.
